scope: Current 4.3 blocking-complete artifacts, read-only visual review; no regeneration or package edits.
limitations: This is agent visual QA, not human approval or production release.
Coordinates, facing, spacing, boundaries and dimensions are schematic, not measured; hall timing does not establish actual running speed or physical feasibility.
Minor demo label/landmark and label/route overlaps mean zero-overlap cannot be claimed.
SVG files and other delivered artifacts were hash-verified; only the 15 PNGs were visually inspected.
This scope is 3 scenes and 4 shots across two examples, not all 39 original-workbook shots.
